en.title: Notice of the 2026 ACDC (AI Cyber Defense Contest)
summary: Notice of the 2026 ACDC (AI Cyber Defense Contest) hosted by the Ministry of Science and ICT and co-organized by KISA and KISIA.
Event period: Tuesday, December 1, 2026 – Wednesday, December 2, 2026.
Location: Grand Ballroom, Grand InterContinental Seoul Parnas.
How to apply: Apply via the QR code on the promotional poster or through the notice section on the KISA website (www.kisa.or.kr).
en.easyExplanation: The 2026 ACDC (AI Cyber Defense Contest) hosted by the Ministry of Science and ICT will take place from December 1 to December 2, 2026, at the Grand InterContinental Seoul Parnas. Anyone interested in AI cybersecurity can apply through the QR code on the poster or the notice board on the KISA website.

originalContent:
과학기술정보통신부가 주최하고 한국인터넷진흥원·한국정보보호산업협회가 공동 주관하는 2026 ACDC(AI Cyber Defense Contest) 개최를 다음과 같이 안내하오니 많은 관심 바랍니다.
가. 행사명: 2026 ACDC(AI Cyber Defense Contest)
나. 일자: 2026. 12. 1.(화) ~ 2026. 12. 2.(수)
다. 장소: 그랜드 인터컨티넨탈 서울 파르나스 그랜드볼룸
라. 주제: AI의 모든 순간에, 사이버보안(AI Everywhere. Cybersecurity Always.)
마. 참가신청: 홍보 포스터 내 QR코드, KISA 누리집(www.kisa.or.kr) 공지사항
